{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicates based on patient_id, keeping the first occurrence
df_clean = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Calculate response rate per site: proportion of responded == 1
response_rate_by_site = df_clean.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Display response rates
print("Response rate by site:\n", response_rate_by_site)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f"\nSite with highest response rate: {highest_site} ({highest_rate})")"}
